author: Joshua Fluke
description:
Apparently corporate LinkedIn has decided employees should now identify as chickens, fish, ants and even different types of sheep.

Yes, really.

One leadership post compares “chicken employees” who simply do their assigned job with “fish employees” who supposedly take ownership beyond their job description, treat company success like personal success and jump into problems whether they belong to them or not.

Another CEO compares employees to ants.

And then we arrive at the corporate masterpiece: the “herd mentality matrix,” where workers are separated into four different types of sheep depending on how well they fit into the herd.

Because apparently being called a sheep at work is career advice now.

In this video, we’re talking about workplace culture, employee engagement, corporate leadership, LinkedIn, management, going above and beyond, employee loyalty, herd mentality and the psychological language companies use to convince workers to act more invested in businesses they don’
title: YOUR BOSS WANTS YOU TO BE A SHEEP AT WORK!
